answer: The wander decay curve is applied at each close, vault records the drop, and mirror recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. Standing decays sharply after 4 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. Every extra alias adds 12 hours of verification and 8 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
